model_manifest.preprocessing_fit_scope: pooled train covariates only; never validation or final-test rows
model_manifest.numeric_preprocessing: train medians; all numeric missing indicators; StandardScaler for ridge/logistic only
model_manifest.categorical_preprocessing: dense one-hot on train categories; unknown categories ignored
model_manifest.profit_transformation: none; zero and negative KRW retained; predictions not clipped
model_manifest.risk_output: positive-class probabilities from LogisticRegression or HGBClassifier
model_manifest.control_repeat_risk_semantics: P(repeat_paid_within_60d=1 | control, X); nonrepeat risk is 1 minus this value
model_manifest.control_repeat_model: fixed train-control LogisticRegression with ridge-family preprocessing
model_manifest.dr_evaluator_selection: not selected here; pipeline must prespecify a common evaluator before validation comparison

overlap.normalization: Horvitz-Thompson full-n, not matching-only or self-normalized

methods.primary: DR policy value minus all-control value; paired scores over every eligible customer.
methods.check: IPW with known assignment probabilities, full-n Horvitz-Thompson normalization.
methods.nuisance: evaluation_profit is the common frozen nuisance; profit remains the allocator ranking input.
methods.bootstrap: Sample within each exact assigned_at batch with replacement; preserve batch sizes, keep duplicate occurrences, rerun fixed allocation and caps.
methods.quantile_method: NumPy linear percentile; two-sided profit and one-sided guardrail bounds.
methods.guardrails: IPW differences for unsubscribe and refund; default 97.5% upper bounds for the selected policy's two-metric family.
methods.score_se: Fixed-action sample score SD/sqrt(n); screening approximation ignores allocation coupling and selection optimism.
methods.uncertainty: Conditional on frozen fitted models/policy and the empirical daily batch pattern in the synthetic world; not full training or real-market uncertainty.
methods.selection_notice: Validation intervals used for candidate selection are selection-dependent, not final-test confirmation.
methods.setup: Fixed rollout setup is separate from reservation caps; charged only if any contact, including in each bootstrap resample. Actual campaign costs already reside in Y.
methods.decision_scope: A candidate label concerns only the evaluated fixed policy; multiple baseline intervals do not provide simultaneous superiority or safety claims.
